notes.title: 🥳DEV BIRTHDAY STREAM! Come celebrate!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315738/e275287e51f36061555b1aa33ec30961b78671ce.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315738/5cb79b627ac32a6309536f7aa69b82e3da8f797e.png[/img] is a story-driven adventure game that follows a little girl as she travels through Icelandic tundra in search of her lost sister. Playing her harmonica, she wards off evil ghosts and makes friends with benevolent spirits that rise in the night. HARU delivers a haunting yet peaceful meditation on grief and fear, especially how they relate to the mind of a child exploring an awe-inspiring and dangerous world.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1581470/HARU/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315738/b4b4440db8ed3134de731bb393ab906ec23ddae6.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Join the two developers of HARU during their livestream on June 19th 5pm PST!
Come celebrate the birthday of one of the devs! [/h1]
